cbv18:0.1: The Factor of Awakening Concerning the Elder Mahā Moggallāna
cbv18:2.1: ° The elder Mahā Moggallāna, having heard that safeguard
cbv18:2.2: from the Sage, at that moment became free from adversity.
cbv18:2.3: It is about the strength of the factors of Awakening, we will recite that safeguard.
cbv18:6.1: The factor of Complete Awakening that is mindfulness, Moggallāna, has been fully explained by me,
cbv18:6.2: when developed and made much of it leads to deep knowledge, Complete Awakening, and Nibbāna.

cbv18:7.2: when developed and made much of it leads to deep knowledge, Complete Awakening, and Nibbāna.
